गो—ष्ठी—बन्ध m. meeting for conversation, Kād. v, 825

s: puM, (pAtIti patiH । gozWyAH pozyavargasya saBAyA vA patiH .) pozyavargapAlakaH । saBApatiH । aTa brAhmaRagozWIpatilakzaRaM yaTA-- “nAnASAstraviSAradE rasikatA satkAvyasammoditA nirddozEH kulaBUzaREH parimitA pUrRA kulajYErapi । SrImadBAgavatAdikAraRakaTASuSrUzayAnanditA gatvABIzwamupEti yadguRijano gozWI hi sA cocyate ॥” evamBUtA gozWI tasyAH patiH । api ca । “kulInAH SrotriyAH sarvve yasyAnnaM BuYjate muhuH । kulInAya sutAM dattvA sa gozWIpatirucyate ॥” tadyaTA । gANgavaMSe lakzmIkAntamajamuyAdAraH 1 muKavaMSe madanaBawwAcAryyaH 2 tadvaMSe ganDarvvarAyaH 3 bandyavaMSe SuBarAjaKAnavaMSaH 4 cawwavaMSe anantaBawwAcAryyaH 5 ete prAcInAH ADunikA bahavaH santi ॥ * ॥ kAyasTagozWIpatilakzaRaM yaTA, -- “nItijYaH kulakarmmaWaH sTitimatAM mAnyo'pi DarmmAnvitaH kAryyAkAryyavilokanEH kulaBftAM sammAnadAnodyataH । pozwA yaH kulasaMvidAM kulasuDIH sanmOlikAnAM taTA sadvaMSapraBavaH kzitO suvidito dAtA sa gozWIpatiH ॥” aTa kAyasTagozWIpatigaRanA । “AdO dvAdaSaparyyaye samaBavaddAnena gozWIpatiH satkIrttiSca subudDiKAnatanayaH SrImantarAyaH kftI । 1 । saMjAtastadanantaraM guRaDarA gaRye ca paryyAyake svecCAto hi purandaraH kulaBavaH KAnaH sadA dAnataH ॥ 2 ॥ paryyAye ca caturddaSe samaBavat pOrandaraH keSavaH svAnaH santatadAnato hi vilasatkIrttirDarAmaRqale ॥ 3 ॥ nAnAvittavisarjanena janitaprotPullakIrttiH kzitAvAsIt paYcadaSe tadAtmajakftI SrIkfzRaviSvAsaKAs ॥ 4 ॥ tataH zoqaSe paryyaye dAnajAlaH kulInAlimAlo dayArAmapAlaH ॥ 5 ॥ tatastatsutaH paryyaye sUryyavAjikzapAnATagaRye'Bavat puRyarAjiH ॥ 6 ॥ tataH paryyaye'zwAdaSe tattanUjaH samAhUya BUyorccitAryyavrajo yaH । sadA satkaTAlApasaMlApatozaH kulInOGapUjAparo'yaM suBAzaH ॥ 7 ॥ AsIt kiNkarasenanAmasukftI yo mOlikEkAgraRIH paryyAye paripUjitAryyanicaye cEkonaviMSe hi saH । sadgozWIpatipAlavaMSatanayApARigraheRAtmano dAnenApi ca melikAwiraparo gozWIpatiH prATamaH ॥ 8 ॥ dAnenAtivadAnyatAdiguRato niHsImapuRyESca yo gopIsiMhacaturDurIRasukftI viMSe hi paryyAyake । yatnAt kiNkarasenavaMSatanayApARigrahAdrAgataH so'pyAsId Buvi melikAwiraparo gozWIpatiH sastutiH ॥ 9 ॥ paryyAye punarekaviMSaka iha KyAtaH kzamAmaRqale gopIsiMhacaturDurIRakulajo yo rAmakAntaH kftI । Danyo gaRyasupuRyajanyayaSasA gozWIpateragraRIrdAnEH karRa ivAtiDEryyapayasAM ratnAkaraScAparaH ॥ 10 ॥ dvAviMSe kila paryyaye'tiniyatestasyAtmajAsaMgrahAt svasyEvAsyasupuRyadattakatanUdBUtasya ca SrImataH । gopImohanasaMjYakasya tanayadvArA ca gozWIpatiH samBUto navakfzRaBUpativaraH sanmelikAwiH kzitO ॥ 11 ॥ tAvanmuKyakanizWamaDyamakulodBUtAM stftIyodBavAn zaqBrAtFnapi tAvato'tra gaRanA badDakramAnAdarAt । sadgozWIpatikArakAnatinatADInAn kulInAn samAhUyAtra prakftAMstaTAtra sahajAn pUjyAMstaTA komalAn ॥ vittErvAgamftErnutipraRatiBiScAnyEstrayoviMSake paryyAye'titarAM prapUjya paramAhlAdAnvitaH SrIyutaH । gopImohanadevavaMSatilako gozWIpatiH kzmApatirjAtaH saMprati BUmidevaGawakAnAYcAYcanAdacyutiH ॥” 12 ॥ iti dakziRarAQIyakAyasTakulAcAryyakArikA ॥ aTa vEdyAnAM gozWIpatiryaTA, -- “vipreBya priyaBojyavastuvasanaM CatrAsanaM BUzaRaM grAmA BUmituraNgamA gajagaRAH svarRAni ratnAni ca । gAvo nAva udAramandiraruco vAwyaSca dattAH sadA sADujYAtikuwumbasadguRagaRAH saMprIRitA yena ca ॥ gOqakzmApatinA ya eva BizajAM SrezWye'BiziktaH kftI nAnASAstraviSAradaH SuBamatirvAgmI cikitsA pawuH । tasmAt prApa gajaM turaNgakanakacCatraYca ratnaM DanaM so'BUt senavinAyako vahuguRErambazWagozWIpatiH ॥ vEnAyakezu sarvvezu BAskaraH SrezWa IritaH । gozWIpatitayA KyAtaH sa vEdyEH pUjito'grataH ॥” iti BaratamallikakftakulapaYjikA ॥

m: 1. गो—ष्ठ m. (n., L.; fr. स्थ, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 97) an abode for cattle, cow-house, cow-pen, fold for cattle, RV.; VS.; AV. &c.

meeting-place, xii, 6547 (= 9953)
with अङ्गिरसाम् N. of a Sāman, TāṇḍyaBr. xiii
अपां ग्˚, a water-vessel, AV. xi, 1, 13
‘refuge (of men)’, Śiva, MBh. xiv, 198
N. of an author, Buddh.
गो—ष्ठ n. = ˚ष्ठी-श्राद्ध, Kull. on Mn. iii, 254
2. गो—ष्ठ Nom. Ā. (fr. 1. -ष्ठ) ˚ष्ठते, to assemble, collect, Dhātup. viii, 4.
गो-ष्ठ &c. See ib.
a: गोष्ठः --ष्ठं — [गावस्तिष्ठंत्यत्र घञर्थे क षत्वम्] (Usually गोष्ठं only) 1 A cowpen, cowhouse, cow-station. --2 A station of cowherds. --ष्ठः An assembly or meeting. --3 An epithet of Śiva. --ष्ठं A purificatory श्राद्ध ceremony. ˚पतिः a chief herdsman. ˚वेदिका a mound or altar in a cowpen. ˚श्वः a dog in a cowpen which barks at every one; applied figuratively to a slanderous person, one who stays idly at home and slanders his neighbours. गोष्ठेपंडितः ‘wise in a cowpen,’ a braggart, vain boaster. गोष्ठेक्ष्वोडिन् m. a boasting coward; also गोष्ठपटु, गोष्ठेप्रगल्भः, --शूरः &c.

k.v: सुराज्ञि देशे राजन्वान्स्यात्ततोऽन्यत्र राजवान्. गोष्ठं गोस्थानकं तत्तु गौष्ठीनं भूतपूर्वकम्.।

a: गोष्ठिः --ष्ठी — f. 1 An assembly, meeting. --2 Society, association. --3 Conversation, chitchat, discourse; गोष्ठी सत्कविभिः समं Bh. 1. 28; Māl. 10. 25; तेनैव सह सर्वदा गोष्ठीमनुभवति Pt. 2. --4 A multitude or collection. --5 Family connections, relatives, especially such as require to be maintained. --6 A kind of dramatic composition in one act. ˚पतिः {1} the chief of an assembly, president. {2} the master of a family.

गो—˚षक m. (fr. -षन्), N. of a Buddh. author.
गो-षक &c. See ib.

v: tri॰ gAM sanoti sana--vic 6 ta॰ “sanoteranaH” pA॰ nAntasya nityazatvanizeDe'pi pUrbapadAt vA zatvam । godAtari “SaMsAmi gozaRo napAt” f॰ 4 । 32 । 22 ।
m: गो—षन् mfn. (√ सन्) = -षणि, RV. iv, 32, 22

s: klI, (gavAM zawkam । “paSuByaH sTAnadvizawke gozWagoyugazaqvam .” iti mugDaboDasUtrAt .) gozawkam । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥
v: na॰ gavAM zawkam go + zaqgabac । gozawke evaM CAgazaNgavAdayaSCAgAdizawke na॰ ।
m: गो—षड्-गव n. 3 pairs of cattle, Vop. vii, 76.
गो—ष-तम See -षन्.
गो—˚ष-तम mfn. (superl.), vi, 33, 5.

v: strIM goriva seDa utseDoyasyAH pUrbapadAt zatvam । durlakzaRAyAM striyAm । “viSvapadIM vfzadatIM gozeDAM viDamAmuta” aTa॰ 1 । 18 । 4 ।
m: गो—षेधा f. (√ सिध्) a kind of evil being, AV. i, 18, 4.

s: klI, (goH padam । yadvA gAvaH padyante gacCanti yasmin deSe । “gozpadaM sevitAsevitapramARezu .” 6 । 1 । 145 । iti suw sasya zatvaYca .) gosevitasTAnam । goKurapramARam । ityamaraH । 3 । 3 । 93 ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 9 । 7 । 37 । “BIzmadroRArRavaM tIrttvA karRapAtAlasamBavam । mA nimajjasva sagaRaH SalyamAsAdya gozpadam ॥”) taTA viSvo medinI ca । “gozpadaM gopadaSvaBre gavAYca gatigocare ॥” (gavAsevitAraRyAdi । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥)
v: na॰ goH padam, gAvaH padyate yasmin deSe vA “gozpadaM sevitAsevitapramARezu” pA॰ sevitAdO zuw । goH padajAte 1 gartte, 2 gopadapramARe ca । 3 goBi sevitadeSe 4 tadasevite vanAdO ca । “bAhuByA sAgaraM tIrttvA laNGituM gozpadaM laGu” rAmA॰ la॰ 69 sa॰ । “BIzmadroRArRRavaM tIrtvA karRapAtAla (baqavAnala) samBavama । mA nimajjasva sagaRaH SalyamAsAdya gozpadam” BA॰ Sa॰ 7 a॰ । 5 praBAMsakzetrasTe tIrTaBede । tatsTAnAdi ska॰ pu॰ praBA॰ “iyaM sarasvatI puRyA sarvadEva hi vidyate । paYcasrotAH praBAse tu duzprApA tridaSErapi । tasyA yatpaYcamaM sroto nyaNkumatyAstawAni ca । tamya maDye sTitaM tIrTaM gozpadeti ca viSrutam” “pApinAM muktidaM tIrTamAdyA rudra gayA smatA । tadAsmin gozpadaM nAma kalO KyAtaM DarAtale । yadA kzIrodamaTanAt prasUtA lokamAtaraH । tadA devi! samantAttu tA gatAstIrTasanniDO । padaM tatra nimagnaM ca nandinyASca SilAMtale । SilAM KurANkitAM dfzwvA jAnudeSANkitAM taTA” ityupakrame devAn prati nandinIvAkyam । “idaM mama padaM devAH! SilAsaMsTaM virAjate । gaganANgaRaBUmisTaM candravimbamivA param । adya praBfti Bo devA! strElokye sacarAcare । gozpadaM nAma viKyAtaM loke KyAtiM gamizya ti” ।
m: गोष्—पद (गोष्-), mfn. (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 145) ‘showing marks of cow's hoofs’, frequented by kine, Kāś.
गोष्—पद n. ‘mark of a cow's foot in the soil’, water filling up such a mark, any small puddle, Suparṇ.; MBh. i, vii, ix; R. vi; BhP. x
गोष्-पद &c. See ib.
a: गोष्पदं — 1 A cow's foot. --2 The mark or impression of a cow's foot in the soil. --3 The quantity of water sufficient to fill such an impression; i. e. a very small puddle. --4 As much as a cow's footstep will hold. --5 A spot frequented by cows.

k.v: गोष्पदं सेविते माने प्रतिष्ठाकृत्यमास्पदम्. त्रिष्विष्टमधुरौ स्वादू मृदू चातीक्ष्णकोमलौ॥
गोष्पदं सेविते माने प्रतिष्ठाकृत्यमास्पदम्. त्रिष्विष्टमधुरौ स्वादू मृदू चातीक्ष्णकोमलौ॥

m: गोष्—पद—मात्र mfn. as large as the impression of a cow's hoof, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 145, Kāś. (cf. गो-पद.)
गोष्—पद—पूरम् ind. so as to fill only the impression of a cow's hoof, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iii, 4, 32 and vi, 1, 145; Bhaṭṭ. xiv, 20
गोष्—पद—प्रम् ind. so as to fill only the impression of a cow's hoof, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iii, 4, 32 and vi, 1, 145; Bhaṭṭ. xiv, 20
गोष्—पद—तृतीया-व्रत n. a kind of religious observance, BhavP.
गोष्—पद—त्रिरात्र-व्रत n. id., ib.
गोषु (loc. pl. of गो).
गोषु—चर mfn. walking among cattle, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 1, Vārtt. 5.
गोषु—युध् mfn. fighting for the sake of cattle (or booty), RV. i, 112, 22; vi, 6, 5; x, 30, 10.

s: Na saMGAte । iti kavikalpadrumaH (BvAMAtmaM-sakaM-sew .) saNGAto rASIkaraRam । Na, gozwate DAnyaM lokaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: saMGAte BvA॰ Atma॰ aka॰ sew । gozwate agozwizwa । jugAzwe ।
m: गो—ष्ट for 2. -ष्ठ, q.v.

v: pu॰ gosaMjYaH stomo'tra । ukTasaMsTe bahumantrAtmake 1 stomaBede । 2 tadupalakzite ekAhasADye yAgaBede ca “sa etAn stomAnapaSyat jyotirgOrAyuritIme vE lokA eteM stomA ayameva jyotirayamBaDyamo gOrasAvuttama AyuH” tA॰ vrA॰ 4 । 1 । 7 । “sa pUrvvoktaH prajApatiH etAn stomAn stomaSabdena trivfdAdistomavantyahAni lakzyante । tAni jyonirgOrAyuriti etannAmakAnyapaSyat । tatra jyotiragnizwomasaMsTaH, gOrAyuScEte ukTasaMsTe॰ jyotiza iyaM stomakxptiH । trivfdbahizpavamAnaM paYcadaSAnyAjAni paYcadaSo mADyandinaH pavamAnaH saptadaSAni pfzWyAni saptadaSa ArBava ekaviMSognizwomasAmeti । aTa gozwomasya, paYcadaSobahizpavamAnaH trivfdAjyAni saptadaSammADyandinaM savanamekaviMSaM tftIyasavanam । aTAyuzwomasya trivfdbahizpavamAnaM paYcadaSAnyAjyAni saptadaSammADyandinaM savanamekaviMSaM tftIyasavanamiti । ete uktAH stomA ime lokA vE BUrAdikAH Kalu, kaH katamoloka iti buButsAyAmAha ayameva lokojyotiH, ayammaDyamo'ntarikzaloko vE asAvuttamastftIyaH svarloka AyuH, stomatrayasya lokatrayeRa saha saMKyAsAmyAt tacCabdatA etEH triBiH stomEH sADanEstrIn lokAn prAjanayaditi SezaHaTEtAn viDatte” BA॰ । “yadete stomA BavantImAneva lokAn prajanayantyezu lokezu pratitizWanti” tA॰ vrA॰ 8 । “yadezo'tirAtro BavatIti vAkyavadetatsarvaM vyAKyeyam । aBiplavazaqahasyottaraM tryahaM viDAtumAha” BA॰ “sa eta ntryahaM punaH prAyuNkta tena zaqahena zawkratUn prAjanayat” tA॰ vrA॰9 । “sa prajApatiretaM pUrvvoktaM tryahaM punaH prayuktavAn । gOrAyurjyotiriti kramo'trAvagantavyaH । taTA cApastambaH “jyotizwomamagnizwomaM raTantarasAmAnaNgAmukTaM vfhatsAmAnamAyuzamukTaM raTantarasAmAnaM jyotizwomaM vfhatsAmAnamiti । nana zaqahena zaw kratUn vasantAdIn prAjanayat sfzwavAn । aTArTavAdAnuguRyAya pUrvvavihitena tryahena saMyujya imamuttaraM tryahaM viDatte” BA॰ । “tadeza zaqaho Bavati ftUneva prajanayanti ftuzu pratitizWanti” tA॰ vrA॰ 10 ।
m: गो—ष्टोम (गो-), m. (स्तोम, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 105, Kāś.) an Ekāha ceremony forming part of the Abhiplava which lasts 6 days (also called गो, q.v.), TS. vii; Lāṭy. x (cf. AitBr. iv, 15 and -स्तोम.)
